text_block_list.text:
I rush back to the academy in pursuit of
Fuji
Kiseki after she left the Yasuda
Kinen by herself,
and I spot a familiar
dark-haired student training
alone.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff! Wheeze! 'Kay, one more lap!
text_block_list.name: Dark-haired Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Hm? You're Fuji's trainer, right? Is
something
wrong?
text_block_list.name: Dark-haired Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
She tells me she saw Фудзи Кисэки heading
toward
the outer perimeter, so I spend
the next few hours
outside searching for
her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Sorry, I really felt like running,
so I came
back ahead of you.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
She greets me breezily. For a moment,
it's as if
nothing is wrong.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But, just as Хиши Амадзон said,
something feels
off about her.
Something is undoubtedly wrong.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, have I worried you? No need
for that. As
you can see, I'm perfectly
fine!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
For better or worse, Фудзи Кисэки is
incredibly good
at acting. She can
conceal her negative feelings
perfectly
behind her mask.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: (But, now that I think of it...)

text_block_list.text: Splash!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Whoops...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry! Yeah, I was just lost in
thought.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
There have been so many moments that
felt off to
me. It's as if she's losing grasp
of her impenetrable
facade.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Whatever is bothering her must be
serious. As I
realize this, I'm overcome
with heavy guilt.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
If only I'd noticed her behavior earlier. If
only if I
was reliable enough for her to
lean on and talk
with...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I just want to make some adjustments to
my form.
I'll head back after I'm done
here, so don't worry.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
But I didn't sense anything was wrong
and I made
her face all of her battles
alone.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
I'm sorry if I don't seem dependable enough to
open up to.

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list:
But please, don't force yourself to shoulder
everything alone.

text_block_list.text:
It's not like that. Please don't make that
face.
None of this is your fault!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to burden you with
negative
feelings, so I kept it all to
myself...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I'll tell you everything. Let's
find
somewhere to sit.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I'm... I'm absolutely terrified of all the

expectations people have put on me.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
You must think it weird considering how,
as an
entertainer, I've always been the
center of
attention and had people
expect great things of
me.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
It's not that I've never felt anxious
before now...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
However, I was always able to convert
my
nervousness into something positive.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I was able to control those feelings. I
thought this
was the path I was meant to
be on. But...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
The enthusiasm the world met me with
after the
end of my classic year was
more passionate than I
could have ever
dreamed.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
News articles were being written on me
every day,
magazines were consistently
sold out... I was
happy about that, of
course...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
But, to be honest... I didn't know what to
do. Or
how to react.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Still, I was determined to do my best
and meet
everyone's expectations. And
because I did that,
my dear schoolmate
was inspired by me and
chose her own
path.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
But when I realized that I had changed
someone
else's life, I started to wonder.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Am I really worthy of such worship and

admiration?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Even if I am right now...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
It's only a matter of time before the day
comes
when I let her down completely.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
The moment I thought that, all the
expectations
that I previously found
comforting turned into
suffocating
pressure.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I've finally decided what path I want to
take, and
it's thanks to you that I was
able to change my
way of thinking.
text_block_list.name: Dark-haired Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки fell oddly quiet after the
younger racer
thanked her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I kept saying that is what encourages me
to go
forward, but I feel like that's not
actually the
case.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: I can't help but think...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I'm not actually deserving of everyone's
hopes.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: I'm weak, and pathetic, and awful.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: You're not. You're none of those things.

text_block_list.text: ...You're so kind.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
You hit the nail on the head when you
said
something was off with my running
today.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
While I was running, I realized I was
unconsciously
making up excuses for
myself.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Things like, "I wasn't good enough for
the big
events of senior year," or "I still
managed to show
everyone a dream just
by taking on this
challenge."
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I wondered what I should do to keep
people from
criticizing me if I ran poorly.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
There I was, standing on a stage
everyone has
high expectations for, in a
competition all dream
to win... and that
was all I could think about.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
...I couldn't get those thoughts out of my
head.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I didn't mean to show you this
side of
me. You must be so
disappointed.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
She does her best to sound nonchalant,
but she
fails to hide the tremor in her
voice.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I can feel a deep and powerful fear like
I've never
felt before coming from within
her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
People's obsession with Фудзи Кисэки is
borderline
terrifying. Everyone expects
the world from her
races.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Even if she was the one who said she'd
put on a
show for them, the hurricane of
fanaticism that
was created in its wake is
unbelievable.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's all right. I'll see this challenge
through.
Everyone's waiting for me, after
all.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Just... give me a bit. I'll be back to
normal in no
time.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I've never seen Фудзи Кисэки so deflated
and unsure
of herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She seems driven by pure obligation, but

considering what happened at the
Yasuda Kinen,
it's obvious she'll crash
and burn if she keeps
going.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: (I don't want her to suffer any more.)

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки is a fantastic runner. She's
given so
many people their own hopes
and dreams.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Traces of her influence have spread wide
and far,
and I want to show her that.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huh? Where are we going?! Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
A certain someone springs to mind, and I
rush
back to the school with Фудзи Кисэки
seeking her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Thankfully, she's still on the field.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff! Wheeze! Huff! I'm not done yet! Raaah!
text_block_list.name: Dark-haired Umamusume

text_block_list.text: It's her...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
We watch as she sprints up a ramp with
all her
energy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
It's thanks to you that she's working toward her
future.

text_block_list.text:
She was in a considerable rut before.
She hated
how her own distance
aptitude limited her and
had no hopes
for her own future.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But those eyes of hers, which were
previously
clouded with so much anger,
are now looking
steadily ahead.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки changed her. She dedicated
the
entirety of her precious classic year
to her
younger schoolmate.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And it's not only the young student who
gained
something from Фудзи Кисэки.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
When people are expectant and
excited, she puts
on a show that matches
their energy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
U-unbelievable! Did you see how fast
she was
going? Фудзи Кисэки's a force to be
reckoned with!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
Right?! She was so mesmerizing, I
couldn't take
my eyes off her!
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text:
When people are anxious and filled with
doubt,
she soothes it away with her calm
presence.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There. You always look better when you
smile.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
No matter who it is, she always gives
them
everything she has.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки isn't an entertainer because
she can
run fast in races.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Charisma and a silver tongue alone don't
make an
entertainer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In order to give everyone the show they
really
want, it won't be enough for me to
simply run and
win.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I'm going to keep working on figuring
out my
limits!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
She's an entertainer because she wants
more than
anyone to make others happy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I understand now...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: I was never alone...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
All this time, I was so focused on not

disappointing you.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I wanted you to always have front row
seats to my
shows as my trainer.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
But, oh, that was just my hubris. You
were never
in the audience.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Ever since the start, you've been
watching over
me from the wings of the
stage.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Her expression relaxes just a bit into its
usual
softness as she speaks.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yes. I like that plan very much.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry I've been so oblivious. And
thank you...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки's woes and troubles are far
from over,
but I know we'll be able to
overcome them
together as a team.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
